FAQ

What audio formats do you accept?

MP3, WAV, M4A and most standard call recording formats. You can also send us transcriptions if you already have them.

Is agent data kept confidential?

Yes. Agent data is processed under strict confidentiality. Performance reports can be anonymized on request. All data is hosted in France and never used to train our models.

Can you analyze calls in several languages?

Yes — 5 native languages: EN, FR, DE, ES, PT-BR. Multilingual call centers are fully supported with no translation layer.

Want to see what 100% of your calls contain?

Send us your last 100 calls or transcriptions — full analysis in 48 hours. Free. No credit card.
